title: Tailored training warm-ups (RAMP; test-day warm-ups unchanged)
what: training.yaml: new warm-ups lift_hinge, lift_squat, upper_lift, run_easy, run_quality, sprint_prep, conditioning; all 25 training templates point at the one matching their main work (z2_bike -> easy). Test-day warm-ups (lower, run, upper, full) unchanged so retests stay comparable. exercises.yaml: glute_bridge, lateral_band_walk, lateral_lunge_bw, high_knee_skip, bodyweight_squat, scap_pull_up (all stock Hevy exercises).
why: Athlete wants warm-ups tailored to the session and to them (disc history, low hip rotation, left groin history, shoulder history), based on good coaching practice and evidence, not variety: raise -> McGill spine prep -> session-specific mobilise/activate -> the lift's own ramp sets or a primer; short static holds only.

history.note: designed in chat; validated + 120-day simulation on the active config
